home.title: Buy the same car together, with prices you can check
home.lede: Join buyers who want the same model in your city. Verified dealers compete with sealed, itemised offers. You decide alone, and your price can only fall.

precommit.title: Before you commit — TEST MODE: no real money
precommit.deposit: You pay a ₹999 test deposit to commit. It holds your place; it is not a booking.
precommit.leave: Leave any time before confirmation (until {decisionDeadline}) and get the full ₹999 back.
precommit.minimum: If the pool doesn't reach {min} committed buyers by {formingDeadline}, it closes and you get the full ₹999 back.
precommit.noOffer: If no dealer makes a valid offer, you get the full ₹999 back. If an offer can't go ahead because too few buyers confirm, you get the full ₹999 back — or, if the pool tries once more, you choose within 48 hours to keep your place or take the refund (no answer means refund).
precommit.ceiling: Later you'll see an exact maximum price (the ceiling) and choose whether to confirm. If more buyers confirm, your price can only fall.
precommit.cancel: If you confirm and later cancel, you still get the full ₹999 back (test mode). Your cancellation never changes anyone else's price.
precommit.dealer: If a dealer cancels or can't deliver the car at the agreed price, you get the full ₹999 back and we open a support case for you automatically.
precommit.refunds: Refunds go back to the original payment method; in test mode no money moves.
precommit.decisionLater: the decision deadline, once offers are in

confirm.title: Confirm at most {ceiling} (cash payable) — TEST MODE
confirm.body: You will never pay more than {ceiling}. If fewer buyers confirm than the dealer's minimum, this offer can't go ahead and your ₹999 test deposit is refunded (or, if the pool tries once more, you choose to keep your place). You can cancel after confirming and still get your ₹999 back.
confirm.drop: If {nextMin}+ buyers confirm by {deadline} the price drops to {nextPrice}.
confirm.consent: If your booking is issued, we share your name and email with this offer's dealer only, so they can arrange delivery. No other dealer gets them.
